name: Yume ni Mita Keshiki
source:
The protagonist meets a mysterious man in her dream.
When she visits the place she saw in the dream, he's there as well.
Seems there's something he wants her to do...

[Translated from [url=http://nanairo777.web.fc2.com/yumenimita/index.html]the official website[/url]]
